items.where: the big round-arched traceried window in the west gable: six lights under a head of circles round a rose
items.how: archSlab frame and glass, five mullions and a transom, the head tracery as a rose ring and seven circle rings; the leading is not drawn

items.where: round-arched three-light side windows with circle tracery either side of the gable, five round-arched windows below, stone sills, side cornices
items.how: same arch helper (redder brick reveal arches, frame, glass, mullions, sill), tracery rings; cornices as stone slabs

items.where: three-storey parsonage: paired ground-floor windows over a stone band, two rows of tall windows, a pointed dormer
items.how: three bays of paired lights, two rows of framed windows with transoms and stone sills; the dormer is not drawn (the 3DBAG roof stops lower)

items.where: round corner bay of the parsonage in darker purple-brown brick, windows on the curve, a door below, rising above the cornice as a drum with its own cornice and a low cap
items.how: 16-sided drum r 1.45 m in greyBrick, stone bands, cornice rings, low dome cap, two windows per upper storey on the curve

items.where: south front: three tall round-arched windows over three lower ones
items.how: arch helper, two lights above, one below, a stone band

items.where: the octagonal entrance porch with a tiled roof and a wide entrance
items.how: 3DBAG porch mass with a dark entrance opening, stone lintel and a small arched window

items.where: polygonal hipped tiled porch roof over a grey eaves fascia, a small stone crest with three knobs at the ridge, the wide square opening with the doors recessed inside
items.how: 3DBAG porch hips snapped to one eaves (5.0 m) and ridge (7.7 m) line; fascia slab, stone crest; the opening drawn as a light reveal panel with a dark door (not cut)

items.where: the arched west door of the tower under a deep brick arch, with a fanlight
items.how: brick archBand, frame archSlab, dark door leaves and glass fanlight

items.where: the tall west tower: a band of four small arched windows, a string course, two tall slit windows; gabled top and spire
items.how: 3DBAG tower mass (to 32.9 m gables, its top compressed into the slate needle) with the window band, courses and slits; r8: paired arched belfry openings on both exposed faces at 23.5-27.5 m and a slender slate spire (9.5 m, octagonal) with an iron finial over the 3DBAG top; the corner pinnacles and the belfry louvres are not drawn

items.where: square shaft to a stone cornice at 26.4 m (three small arched windows a face below it), corner broaches, an octagonal stage with paired small arched windows, a clock on each shaft face (dial centre 31.8 m) and louvred openings on the diagonals, cornice at 33.8 m, octagonal slate spire with flared foot to ~47.5 m, gilt ball and star
items.how: 3DBAG tower cut at 26.4 m (reshapeShell compress); octagon prisms and frustums aligned to the shaft, broach tetrahedra, clock discs and hands, arch openings; spire lucarnes skipped
